known_differences.description: CASP runtime is a FrankenSciPy innovation with no SciPy equivalent. All behavior is novel.

threats.description: NaN or Inf signal values in DecisionSignals can corrupt logit computation and softmax posterior, leading to incorrect policy decisions. Clamping to [0,1] mitigates but extreme values (Inf) may still produce unexpected behavior before clamping.
threats.mitigation: DecisionSignals provides is_finite() check. Logit computation clamps all signal values to [0,1] range before use. NaN signals are clamped to 0.0.
threats.strict_mode_response: Clamping applied unconditionally; no explicit error for non-finite signals.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Same clamping behavior; callers should check is_finite() pre-decision.

threats.description: Hard classification of matrix condition state into unit posterior (100% probability) means any misclassification of the condition state propagates directly into solver selection with no hedging. If condition estimation is wrong, the selected solver may be inappropriate.
threats.mitigation: ConformalCalibrator monitors backward errors and triggers SVD fallback when empirical miscoverage rate exceeds threshold, providing a safety net for systematic misclassification.
threats.strict_mode_response: SVD fallback triggered by calibrator when drift detected.

threats.description: Bounded circular buffer (default 200 entries) means the calibrator has finite memory. Long-running applications that alternate between good and bad phases may not detect drift if the violation window is larger than the buffer capacity.
threats.mitigation: Buffer capacity is configurable at construction. Applications with long drift windows should increase capacity. Minimum 10 observations before fallback triggers prevents false positives during warmup.
threats.strict_mode_response: No fallback with fewer than 10 observations regardless of violation rate.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Same behavior; warmup threshold is unconditional.

threats.description: PolicyEvidenceLedger records all decision evidence including signal values, posteriors, and actions. In multi-tenant environments, this audit trail could leak information about one workload's numerical characteristics to another.
threats.mitigation: Evidence ledger is bounded (FIFO eviction) and local to each PolicyController instance. No cross-instance sharing. Callers are responsible for access control on evidence data.
threats.test_reference: N/A (architectural concern, not testable via fixture)
